messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Error in loading the user specified variables
parts:
You can try doing this in R: use the terra::mask() function with the is.na() function to find and replace NA values within your rasters.

This error message occurs because some downstream analyses will not work if there are nonuniform NA values within the env data.
